title: Positive autocorrelation at unit lag for stationary random walk Metropolis-Hastings in ${\mathbb R}^d$
summary: It is often asserted in the literature that one should expect positive autocorrelation for random walk Metropolis-Hastings (RWMH), especially if the typical proposal step-size is small relative to the variability in the target density. In this paper, we consider a stationary RWMH chain ${\bf X}$ taking values in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space and (subject only to the existence of densities with respect to Lebesgue measure) with general target distribution having finite second moment and general proposal random walk step-distribution.
